crossRefs.note: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man, and a drunkard; a friend of tax…

translations.web: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
translations.bsb: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.
translations.kjv: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
translations.asv: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, That was to my reproach.
